rationale: The bid-ask spread of 373.9 bps creates an immediate structural disadvantage that makes any directional trade extremely difficult to profit from — the spread alone consumes a large portion of any realistic intraday move. The stock has gapped down nearly 8% on elevated relative volume and is currently sitting near the low of the session range (30.4% position) with no clear stabilization pattern, making both long and short entries high-risk without a defined technical anchor. The combination of extreme illiquidity, a wide spread, and chaotic early price action (range of $13+ in the first few minutes) warrants a skip until structure develops.
